articles.title: This bitcoin miner rejected BIP-110 despite mining through a pool that supported it
articles.snippet: Ocean, a bitcoin mining pool, had been backing BIP-110 by default. Simple Mining, a company that runs mining machines through Ocean, used software from the pool that lets individual miners choose for themselves and went the other way.
